# Authorised Release Approver GitHub handles.
#
# One handle per line, without the leading @.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# Read by .github/scripts/validate_release_integrity.py FROM THE BASE
# BRANCH (not the PR head). A hostile PR that tried to add its own
# author to this file could not use the modified version to pass its
# own check — the base branch's version is the one consulted.
#
# .github/CODEOWNERS requests review on changes to this file from
# @agenticprocessprotocol/custodians and
# @agenticprocessprotocol/release-approvers; once code-owner review is
# enforced, an approval from either team satisfies it. It is not yet
# enforced by the main ruleset (APP-DEC-0004 §4). Until then a change
# needs one approval from someone other than the last pusher and Release
# Approver sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md §2.2, governance and CI changes).
